items.title: 집 묘사
items.question: You indicated in your background survey that you live in an apartment. Tell me about your home. What does it look like? What types of rooms does it have?
script:
I live in a small studio apartment in downtown Seoul.
It's located in the center of Seoul.

Actually, I don't have a bedroom in my apartment because it's a small studio.
But it has a really nice bathroom and a spacious kitchen area.
My apartment is very clean and modern. so I really like my place.

What makes my apartment special is a big window.
Whenever I open it, I can get some fresh air.
Also, the window lets in a lot of light. and that makes my studio super bright and cheerful.

So, Anyway, my home is the best place for me to relax and chill out.
I know my studio is very small, but it's cozy and comfortable.
keywords: 서울 도심의 작은 원룸 (small studio apartment)
아주 좋은 욕실 + 넓은 주방 공간
특별한 점: 큰 창문 → 열면 신선한 공기
햇빛이 많이 들어와 밝고 쾌활한 분위기
마무리: relax and chill out · 작지만 아늑하고 편안함
